Skills
 Mid-Level Software Developer – Grow Your Skills With Us  
 Are you a mid-level developer with 3+ years of experience who wants to keep learning, take on new challenges, and grow into a stronger developer?  
 Join us in our mission to deliver world-class software in an environment where your professional and personal development is our top priority. Expect close teamwork with experienced colleagues as you take your career to the next level.
 The job 
 Together with your team, you will be responsible for the continuous development, improvement, and maintenance of our product SitaWare Headquarters - a powerful and scalable C4I system (Command, Control, Communications, Computers, & Intelligence).
 Your everyday tasks will consist of:
Troubleshoot, optimize and solve complex problems in an existing codebase 
Design and implement new features together with our Domain Experts and User Experience engineers 
Ensure the quality of the solution by reviewing and inspecting the design and code made by your colleagues 
 Joining the team 
 The team consists of a project manager, an architect, 7 developers, 2 testers, and 1 tester intern. It is our oldest and most stable team in the Bucharest office. Most team members have worked together for several years and together they are proactive and take responsibility needed for the team to deliver on their commitments and expectations from stakeholders.
 What we’re looking for:
You hold a bachelor’s or master’s degree in a relevant development education. 
Someone who shares our passion for programming, who is not afraid of complex problems and who is willing to learn and, in return, help others to grow and improve. 
Experience is important for us, so we are looking for people who have been active in the field for at least 3-4 years, with solid knowledge of Java technologies (Spring, JPA/Hibernate, JUnit, Mockito) and Angular. You should be comfortable working with Angular on a daily basis, as a large part of our work is frontend. 
We would like you to be part of our very outspoken and energetic team, where we like to promote creativity by constantly sparring with each other and bouncing off ideas, so don’t be afraid to speak up. 
Communicate in English both verbally and in writing with many different stakeholders and at all levels of the organization. 
 The role covers both backend and frontend development, but we are especially keen to find a frontend-oriented developer who is passionate about building great user experiences and has a strong interest in Angular.
 It would be a plus:
Prior knowledge and experience with SCRUM or Kanban 
Prior interaction with the defence domain or other mission-critical applications is a very welcome bonus 
Knowledge of some of the technologies that we use:
Scala 
AngularJS, PostGre 
Development tools (Jira, Bitbucket, Wiki, Git, IntelliJ, TeamCity) 
Web technologies:
 AngularJS, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3/SCSS, Jasmine, Karma 
Other technologies:
 Gradle, npm, PostgreSQL, Microsoft SQL Server 
We are also looking into future technologies such as Kafka/RabbitMQ, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS/Azure, AI. 
 Please note that you must be able to present a clean criminal record and have lived in a NATO and/or an EU country for the past seven years as we work with security-classified projects. Read more here:
 https:
//systematic.com/int/careers/security-clearance/
 Never stop developing 
 Systematic is uniquely people-centric, truly international and proudly rooted in Denmark with more than 1300 employees. Together, we write intelligent and innovative code to drive progress and improve lives. We develop IT solutions that make a real difference where it matters most. This is why we never stop developing. Here, there is room to be professional and personal. It is not just a place to work but a place to belong. 
 Start your development here 
 We will be assessing applications on an ongoing basis as we wish to welcome our new colleague as soon as possible, so click Apply Now and send us your CV today. If you have any questions, you are always welcome to contact the recruiter, Andra Haidau (andra.haidau@systematic.com).
 Welcome to Systematic Bucharest
 Systematic Romania, the second-largest office with 200 employees, is conveniently located near Piata Romana. You can start your day with a delicious breakfast in the canteen and choose the option to order fresh meals for lunch. Find daily fruits and beverages and step out onto the terrace for a breath of fresh air. The recreation room offers board games, foosball, and table tennis for some friendly competition, and we even provide office massage sessions to help you relax. Thanks to our Employees' Club, you can join exciting social events like karting, treasure hunts, and themed parties. Plus, getting here is easy with an indoor parking lot and public transport just around the corner. 
 What we offer:
 At Systematic, we focus on both personal and professional growth within a stable and innovative work environment that prioritizes employee well-being.
Hybrid setup:
 office and remote work.
